findings.title: Lithuanian totp step replaced with Italian text
findings.body: loginTotpStep1 was changed from a Lithuanian string to the Italian "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:". This looks like a bad copy/paste when removing the links. Lithuanian users will see Italian text. The same wrong text is applied to the Lithuanian account messages_lt.properties totpStep1.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese file given Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: totpStep1 in the zh_CN file now uses Traditional Chinese (在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：), copied from zh_TW. Simplified Chinese users get the wrong script; it should be simplified (在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：).

findings.title: English file derivation is fragile and fails hard
findings.body: The English reference path is derived by regex replacement on the absolute path. `replaceAll("resources-community","resources")` and the `_xx.properties` replacement will also affect directory names containing such patterns. The greedy `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties` can match from an earlier underscore in the file name. If the English file is missing (e.g. theme directories with no `_en`, such as the account-ui or admin-ui community files), a RuntimeException aborts the build rather than reporting a verification message. Admin-ui community files live under `maven-resources-community` which is not rewritten to `maven-resources`, so lookups there may fail.

findings.title: Anchor check mutates value and breaks after first mismatch with stale matcher
findings.body: santizeAnchors iterates a matcher over `value` while reassigning `value` via replaceFirst; the matcher still scans the original string, and replaceFirst removes the first textual occurrence, which may not be the one matched. Also, extra English anchors not present in the translation are not detected, and the added message lacks the key and file name, making it hard to locate.

findings.title: Weak tests for sanitizer
findings.body: Tests only assert that some message contains a substring. There is no positive test that valid HTML (e.g. allowed <b>, matching anchors, the choice-format or templateHelp exceptions) passes with no messages, so false positives from the sanitizer normalization would go unnoticed.
